description: This file defines the Trend class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing constants for different trend types, static properties for trend configurations, and a method to calculate and retrieve trend analysis models based on provided data. It serves as a core component for trend analysis in spreadsheet computations.

classes.name: Trend
classes.description: Provides static methods and constants for trend analysis computations, including various trend types and the calculation method.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Performs trend analysis based on specified trend type and data arrays, returning an instance of a trend model or false if invalid.
